squat.insufficient_depth.what: You're not reaching a full squat depth.
squat.insufficient_depth.why: Stopping short of parallel gives the glutes and hamstrings less time under tension, making the squat less effective.
squat.insufficient_depth.whatToChange: Keep lowering until your hip crease drops at least to knee height before driving back up.
squat.insufficient_depth.cue: Sit back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
squat.insufficient_depth.drill: Box squats to a chair or bench just below parallel, focusing on a controlled, full-depth sit.

squat.excessive_forward_lean.what: Your torso is leaning too far forward during the squat.
squat.excessive_forward_lean.why: Excessive forward lean shifts load onto your lower back and away from your legs.
squat.excessive_forward_lean.whatToChange: Keep your chest up and torso more vertical as you descend.
squat.excessive_forward_lean.cue: Proud chest, sit down not forward.
squat.excessive_forward_lean.drill: Goblet squats holding a light weight at chest height to cue a more upright torso.
